owner: daily blog workflow, integration bundle policy and the hygiene admission closure check
root_cause: The daily blog workflow adds config/bg-static-i18n-en.d/powerhouse-blog-<date>.json to its candidate commit, but config/powerhouse-integration-bundle-v1.json only exempted blog/ and sitemap.xml from the closure artifacts. A candidate with that patch is a material change outside the runtime prefixes, so hygiene / admission rejected it with INTEGRATION_BUNDLE_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE: activity_ledger,brain_learning,human_documentation, and the required check test stayed red. The 2026-11-07 candidate (PR #5517) was the first to hit it; the 2026-11-06 candidate had hand-added closure files.
prevention_rule: The patch prefix is added to runtimeClosurePathPrefixes and a dependency-free test reads the git add paths from the workflow and requires each one to be covered, so a new staged path cannot ship without its exemption. The exemption stays limited to powerhouse-blog- patches under a content-publication obligation. A planned-action trigger blocks plans that add a staged path to the daily blog workflow until the closure prefixes are acknowledged.
